subject: MAP + evaluation bundle: handoff schedule & restricted prompt-pack access
messages:
From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivelabs.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Request: exchange eval bundle + prompt pack for pilot

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the demo earlier — the team at Olive Labs is excited to run a short pilot. To move forward we need a small evaluation bundle (test cases + prompt pack) under a Mutual Action Plan so our QA and data teams can validate model behavior on our edge cases.

Key asks:
- One-time access to a sandboxed eval bundle (approx ~5k test items) for 30 days
- A limited prompt pack with usage restrictions (no downstream redistribution)
- MAP with milestones and acceptance criteria for the pilot

Can you share Redwood's standard MAP template and an outline for how you typically gate prompt-pack access? Also cc'ing our procurement (procurement@olivelabs.com) for contract steps.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Nguyen
Head of ML Products, Olive Labs

Attachments: none
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivelabs.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: exchange eval bundle + prompt pack for pilot

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Welcome onboard.

High level approach (proposed MAP):
1) Week 0 (signing): exchange MAP draft + confidentiality & usage covenant
2) Week 1 (ingest): Redwood provisions sandbox with ephemeral tokens; we deliver eval bundle as an encrypted archive
3) Week 2-4 (validation): Olive runs acceptance tests; share failing example set for joint triage
4) Week 5 (decision): acceptance / go/no-go + next steps (pilot expand or takedown)

Access controls we require for the prompt pack:
- Ephemeral access tokens tied to Olive’s sandbox project ID
- No redistribution clause (we provide a one-way, access-only pack)
- Usage log retention for 90 days; logs available to you and to our security team on request

I attached two starter artifacts: map_draft_v1.xlsx (skeleton MAP) and usage_covenant_v1.pdf (restricts redistribution + retention terms). Lauren will share Redwood’s MPA template and a lightweight SLA note for the sandbox.

Questions for you (so we can finalize timeline):
- Who will be the Olive signatory for a lightweight MPA?
- Any specific compliance requirements beyond SOC2 (e.g., data residency in us-east-1)?

If procurement is ready we can route MPA via DocuSign; otherwise we can run a short handoff call on Monday.

—
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Attachments: map_draft_v1.xlsx, usage_covenant_v1.pdf
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@olivelabs.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: exchange eval bundle + prompt pack for pilot

Hi Sarah — looping in procurement + ops guidance.

I’ve attached: redwood_mpa_template.docx (minimal MPA we use for evaluation bundles) and SLA_notes.txt (sandbox SLOs + token lifecycle). Summary below:

Operational guardrails (short):
- Provisioning: Redwood will stage the eval bundle in a read-only sandbox bucket (us-east-1)
- Tokens: ephemeral tokens expire after 30 days; token issuance requires a designated Olive project lead
- Logging: request/response logs retained for 90 days; audit export available on request
- Data handling: Olive may not persist or redistribute the prompt pack; derived metrics are allowed

Acceptance criteria (example):
- Pass rate >= 85% on core intent items (we'll agree on a 500-sample acceptance set)
- No PII leakage flagged in 3 consecutive spot checks

Planned timeline:
- EOD Mon (2026-12-13): finalize signatory and return redlines
- Tue (2026-12-14): issue sandbox tokens and upload eval bundle
- Tue–Mon (2026-12-14 → 2026-12-20): Olive validation window
- Tue (2026-12-21): acceptance call and next-step decision

If procurement prefers, we can send the MPA via DocuSign link (I can start that once we have the signatory name).

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Contracts, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_mpa_template.docx, SLA_notes.txt

Thanks Lauren + Jasmine — that aligns with our internal timeline. Procurement (cc) is the signatory for MPA on our side: Rebecca Cole (procurement@olivelabs.com).

Next steps from Olive:
- Rebecca will review the MPA template this morning and confirm any redlines by EOD Monday 2026-12-13
- We prefer DocuSign for the final signature flow; please send a link when ready
- One operational question: can Redwood limit prompt-pack unpacking to the sandbox container only (i.e., provide pack as read-only mounted artifact rather than a downloadable archive)? If yes that would help our security team sign off faster.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get the tests running.

Best,
Sarah
